title: 第4693章 君逍遥救场，苍茫星空当代唯一的君家天骄
content_zh:
漫天血雨纷飞，全场却是一片死寂。
所有人都是屏住了呼吸。
目光呆呆地看着那位白衣男子。
南宫正等人，脸色更是有一瞬的凝滞。
而后双目之中，顿时浮现出了一抹近乎狂热的尊崇之色！
“盟主大人！”
南宫正等人脱口而出。
“是君公子，君公子来了！”
在场其余当世天骄，也是纷纷忍不住出声。
他们并非是逍遥盟之人。
但此刻，看到君逍遥现身。
他们的情绪之激动，并不比逍遥盟之人弱多少。
因为他们实在是太憋屈了。
能来到仙土的天骄，哪一个不是人中龙凤，心高气傲。
结果却是遭到了那些尘封天骄这般羞辱打压。
换做是谁都无法接受，令他们心中都是憋着一口气。
而现在，君逍遥现身。
直接是以最为震撼人心的方式，一掌拍死了烈金族尘封天骄卓天。
这无疑是让众人在震撼的同时，也感觉到了一种畅快。
他们觉得，自己与君逍遥，同为当世天骄，是站在一边的。

而虚空中，小妖后愣了愣，看着面前君逍遥修长挺拔的背影。
她的眼前，忽然模糊了。
难以言喻的情绪在心中翻腾。
欣喜，高兴，酸涩，无奈……
这个人，终归还是出现了。
只可惜……
感受着自己体内紊乱到几乎不受控制的力量。
小妖后唇角流露出一抹苦涩之意。
她方才已经燃烧了诸多自身的本源。
这是不可逆的损伤。
同时为了不被那卓天镇压，她选择了自爆。
此刻，她体内规则紊乱，法则逆冲，五脏六腑都好似要扭曲一般。
这是一种难以忍受的剧痛。
比千刀万剐还要痛苦万倍。
但是，此刻的小妖后，却好似感受不到那种痛苦。
因为她的眼前，只有君逍遥的身影。
“再见了……”
小妖后只感觉眼前一黑，天旋地转，像是要坠入无尽的黑暗之中。
然而下一刻。
她便是感觉到，自己坠入到了一个温暖的怀抱之中。

她勉强让自己睁开双眼。
便是见到了君逍遥那张俊秀无伦的五官轮廓。
“君逍遥……”
小妖后嗓音虚弱喃喃。
她现在算是明白了。
为何颜如梦等女子，都对君逍遥那般痴迷情深。
因为这种被人保护的感觉，是真的很不错。
可惜，她已经很难再享受了。
“我来晚了……”
君逍遥看了一眼小妖后，也是微微一叹。
他也没想到小妖后是个如此刚烈的女子。
感受着小妖后体内紊乱暴动的气息。
君逍遥微微皱眉。
而后抬手而起，磅礴的法则之力在他手中汇聚，涌入小妖后体内。
霎时间，那暴动紊乱的气息，就被君逍遥给镇压了下去。
但这并不代表小妖后就脱离了危险。
毕竟她的本源消耗很大，而且那种损失是不可逆的。
“逍遥……”
另一边，颜如梦竭力摆脱了纠缠，遁向君逍遥这边。
“如梦……”

君逍遥看了一眼颜如梦。
可以说，在得到了梦主的传承后。
颜如梦的实力，也是不可同日而语。
不过再强，终究也有一个极限。
面对几位仙土深处尘封的人物，还是力有不逮。
“逍遥，妖妖她……”
颜如梦眼中有泪，看着妖妖。
她唇角染血，面色苍白如纸。
颜如梦心中很自责。
如果她实力再强一点的话。
会不会妖妖，还有逍遥盟的人，都不会有事情。
“别急，她现在暂无性命之忧，你照顾好她，我先解决一些事情。”君逍遥道。
颜如梦微微颔首，接过了妖妖，将其抱住。
君逍遥转身，目光淡漠扫过那些尘封天骄。
在解决了妖庭太子之事后。
君逍遥也是一路深入仙土。
沿途，他也是听到了关于尘封天骄不让当世天骄进入仙土深处的消息。
唯有同门同势力的尘封天骄允许，当世天骄才能进入。
对此，君逍遥其实是无感的，他也并不在乎。
别说云族，天谕仙朝，乃至君家，都有在仙土尘封的天骄。

就算没有。
又有哪个尘封天骄，敢阻止他君逍遥进入？
所以，一开始君逍遥得知这个消息时。
他是不准备掺和此事的，直接进入仙土深处就可以了。
但是，在感应到颜如梦等人的气息后。
君逍遥便是一路来此。
他很少会有震怒的情绪，大多时候都云淡风轻。
但是现在，君逍遥的脸色，很是淡漠。
他并不想掺和此事，但似乎有人很不长眼睛。
而同时，在场诸多当世天骄，目光皆是齐齐汇聚在君逍遥身上。
“是君公子来了，我们有救了！”
“君公子的实力果然恐怖，一招就灭了那烈金族的尘封天骄。”
“让那些尘封天骄嚣张啊，现在看他们还有何话说！”
周围天地间，响起诸多喧嚣。
别说南宫正等逍遥盟之人了。
就算不是逍遥盟的人，此刻也是对君逍遥有种认同感。
希望他能狠狠打脸那些尘封天骄。
而在场的几位尘封天骄，目光看向君逍遥，也是带着丝丝惊异之色。
卓天身为烈金族的尘封天骄，实力绝对不算弱。
至少也不会比他们几位弱到哪里去。

但是，竟然被那位年轻白衣男子一招秒了。
这有点恐怖了。
“怎么会……”
哪怕是一直在一旁抱臂看戏的玄阴族尘封天骄，也是下意识放下手臂，露出错愕之意。
说实话，他的实力也没比卓天强到哪里去。
也就是说，这位白衣男子，想杀他也不会太过困难？
这让几位尘封天骄，都是有些难以置信。
而在场，唯有皇拓疆，神情还算镇定。
只是他的眉宇，也是微微一皱。
之前，听到皇霓儿说君逍遥此人，有多么强大。
他还以为，是那种修炼了最少几万年乃至十万年的人物。
这样的修炼时间看似漫长，但其实对于修士而言，也依旧是年轻一代。
然而，皇拓疆能看出来。
君逍遥很年轻！
这种年轻，不是那种相对的年轻。
而是他的真正年岁，绝对不会有多大。
皇拓疆甚至猜测，此人可能只有万岁，最多不过数万岁。
要知道，对于他们这些尘封天骄而言。
修炼十万年也是很正常的事情。
如此年轻，却有这般实力，能秒杀卓天这等尘封天骄。

即便是在皇拓疆所在的时代，都是极为不可思议，没有几个这样的妖孽。
“你就是君逍遥，苍茫星空当代唯一的一位君家天骄。”
content_en:
There was blood raining all over the sky, but the whole place was completely silent.
Everyone held their breath.
He stared blankly at the man in white.
Nangong Zheng and the others' expressions became stagnant for a moment.
Then, an almost fanatical look of respect suddenly appeared in his eyes!
"Lord Leader!"
Nangong Zheng and others blurted out.
"It's Mr. Jun, Mr. Jun is here!"
The rest of the world's geniuses present couldn't help but speak out.
They are not from the Xiaoyao Alliance.
But at this moment, Jun Xiaoyao appeared.
Their emotional excitement is not much weaker than that of the people of Xiaoyao League.
Because they are really frustrated.
Among the talented people who can come to the fairyland, they are not the best among people, and they are arrogant and arrogant.
As a result, he was humiliated and suppressed by those dusty geniuses.
No one could accept it, which made them all hold their breath in their hearts.
But now, Jun Xiaoyao appears.
Directly and in the most shocking way, he slapped Zhuotian, the dust-free genius of the Liejin clan, to death with one palm.
This undoubtedly made everyone feel a sense of relief while being shocked.
They felt that they were on the same side as Jun Xiaoyao, who was both the genius of the world.
In the void, the Little Demon Queen was stunned, looking at Jun Xiaoyao's slender and straight back in front of her.
Her vision suddenly blurred.
Unspeakable emotions surged in my heart.
Joy, happiness, sourness, helplessness...
This person finally appeared.
It's a pity...
Feeling the chaotic and almost uncontrollable power in his body.
There was a hint of bitterness on the corners of the Little Demon Queen's lips.
She had just burned a lot of her own roots.
This is irreversible damage.
At the same time, in order not to be suppressed by Na Zhuo Tian, ​​she chose to self-destruct.
At this moment, the rules in her body were chaotic, the laws were in conflict, and her internal organs seemed to be distorted.
It was excruciating pain.
It is ten thousand times more painful than being cut into pieces by a thousand cuts.
However, at this moment, the Little Demon Queen seemed to be unable to feel the pain.
Because in front of her eyes, there was only Jun Xiaoyao's figure.
"Goodbye..."
The Little Demon Queen felt her eyes go dark, and the world was spinning, as if she was about to fall into endless darkness.
But the next moment.
She just felt that she fell into a warm embrace.
She forced herself to open her eyes.
It was when he saw Jun Xiaoyao's handsome facial features.
"Jun Xiaoyao..."
The Little Demon Queen murmured in a weak voice.
She finally understands.
Why are Yan Rumeng and other women so obsessed with Jun Xiaoyao?
Because this feeling of being protected is really good.
Unfortunately, it was hard for her to enjoy it anymore.
"I'm late..."
Jun Xiaoyao glanced at the Little Demon Queen and sighed slightly.
He also didn't expect the Little Demon Queen to be such a strong woman.
Feeling the chaotic and violent aura within the Little Demon Queen's body.
Jun Xiaoyao frowned slightly.
Then he raised his hand, and the majestic power of law gathered in his hand and poured into the Little Demon Queen's body.
In an instant, the rioting and chaotic aura was suppressed by Jun Xiaoyao.
But this does not mean that the Little Demon Queen is out of danger.
After all, her origins were consumed a lot, and that loss was irreversible.
"Xiaoyao..."
On the other side, Yan Rumeng tried her best to get rid of the entanglement and fled to Jun Xiaoyao.
"Like a dream..."
Jun Xiaoyao glanced at Yan Rumeng.
It can be said that after receiving the inheritance of the Dream Master.
Yan Rumeng's strength is also incomparable.
But no matter how strong you are, there is a limit after all.
Facing several dust-covered figures deep in the fairyland, he is still unable to cope.
"Xiaoyao, Yaoyao, she..."
Yan Rumeng looked at Yaoyao with tears in her eyes.
The corners of her lips were stained with blood, and her face was as pale as paper.
Yan Rumeng felt very guilty.
If she were stronger.
Will Yaoyao and the people of Xiaoyao League be fine?
"Don't worry, she is temporarilyThere is no need to worry about her life. You take good care of her and I will solve some things first. "Jun Xiaoyao said.
Yan Rumeng nodded slightly, took Yaoyao and hugged him.
Jun Xiaoyao turned around and scanned the dusty geniuses with indifferent eyes.
After solving the case of the Demon Court Prince.
Jun Xiaoyao also went all the way deep into the fairy land.
Along the way, he also heard news about the dust-covered genius who would not let the current generation's genius enter the depths of the fairy land.
Only with the permission of the dust-free geniuses from the same sect and the same power can the current genius enter.
Jun Xiaoyao was actually indifferent to this, and he didn't care.
Not to mention the Yun Clan, the Tianyu Immortal Dynasty, and even the Jun family all have talented people who are gathering dust in the immortal land.
Even if not.
Which arrogant person dares to stop him, Jun Xiaoyao, from entering?
So, when Jun Xiaoyao learned the news at first.
He was not going to get involved in this matter, he could just go directly into the depths of the Immortal Land.
However, after sensing the aura of Yan Rumeng and others.
Jun Xiaoyao came here all the way.
He rarely gets angry, and most of the time he is calm and calm.
But now, Jun Xiaoyao's expression was very indifferent.
He didn't want to get involved in this matter, but it seemed that someone was very short-sighted.
At the same time, the eyes of many talented people present were all focused on Jun Xiaoyao.
"Master Jun is here, we are saved! "
"Young master Jun's strength is indeed terrifying, he destroyed the arrogant genius of the Liejin clan with one move. "
"Let those dusty geniuses be so arrogant, let's see what they have to say now! "
There was a lot of noise in the surrounding heaven and earth.
Not to mention that Nangong is waiting for someone from the Xiaoyao League.
Even if he is not from the Xiaoyao League, he still feels a sense of identification with Jun Xiaoyao at this moment.
I hope he can give those talented people a hard slap in the face.
The few talented people present looked at Jun Xiaoyao with a hint of surprise.
As a prodigy of the Liejin Clan, Zhuo Tian is definitely not weak in strength.
At least he won't be any weaker than a few of them.
However, he was instantly killed by the young man in white.
This is a bit scary.
"How could..."
Even the dusty genius of the Xuanyin clan who had been watching the show with his arms folded subconsciously lowered his arms, showing a look of astonishment.
To be honest, his strength is not much stronger than Zhuo Tian's.
In other words, it wouldn't be too difficult to kill this man in white?
This made several dusty geniuses feel a little unbelievable.
At the scene, only Huang Tuojiang looked calm.
But his eyebrows also frowned slightly.
Before, I heard Huang Nier say how powerful Jun Xiaoyao was.
He thought he was the kind of person who had been practicing for at least tens of thousands or even a hundred thousand years.
This kind of training time may seem like a long time, but in fact, for the monks, they are still of the younger generation.
However, Huang Tuojiang could see it.
Jun Xiaoyao is very young!
This kind of youth is not the kind of relative youth.
But his real age will definitely not be that old.
Huang Tuojiang even guessed that this person might only live ten thousand years, or at most tens of thousands.
You know, for these talented people like them.
It is also normal to practice for one hundred thousand years.
He is so young, but has such strength that he can kill Zhuo Tian in an instant.
Even in Huang Tuojiang's era, it was extremely unbelievable, and there were not many such monsters.
"You are Jun Xiaoyao, the only Jun family genius in the contemporary era in the vast starry sky. "
